'''Reolis Riptusk''' is a [[forest troll]] quest giver located in [[Amani'Alor]] in [[Stonetalon Mountains]].

==Quests==
He started the following quests, all of which gave [[Revantusk Trolls]] reputation:
*{{Horde}} [60] [[A Donation of Wool: Revantusk Tribe]]
*{{Horde}} [60] [[A Donation of Silk: Revantusk Tribe]]
*{{Horde}} [60] [[A Donation of Mageweave: Revantusk Tribe]]
*{{Horde}} [60] [[A Donation of Runecloth: Revantusk Tribe]]
*{{Horde}} [60] [[Additional Runecloth: Revantusk Tribe]] (Repeatable)

==Speculation==
He may be related to [[Talkharu Riptusk]] and [[Ranor Riptusk]].
